<<prodname>> and Cisco Contact Center Enterprise (CCE) integration currently supports three channels - SMS, Email, and Live Chat. Here are the details of how you can configure the channel assets for each of these channels within <<prodname>>.

| Channel                     | Documentation                                                                                                   |
| :-------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| SMS                         | [SMS Asset Creation](doc:wxcc-sms-assset-creation)                                                              |
| Email                       | [Email Asset Creation](doc:wxcc-email-asset-creation)                                                           |
| Live Chat                   | [LiveChat Asset Creation](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/wxcc-livechat-asset-creation)                         |
| Apple Messages for Business | [Apple Messages for Business Asset Creation](https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/apple-messages-for-business-cce) |
| Facebook Messenger          | [Facebook Messenger Asset Creation](https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/facebook-messenger-cce)                   |
| WhatsApp                    | [WhatsApp Asset Creation](https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/whatsapp-cce)                                       |

> 📘 Web CallBack
> 
> Web CallBack is not a native channel of <<prodname>> Please refer to the configuration related details on nodes in the [Flow Configurations](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/flow-configurations) topic.
